Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Raman Mishra

Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Santosh Kumar Tripathi,
who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant and perused the record.
The Vakalatnama is taken on record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.491 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376,
342 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Nanpara, District Bahraich.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.

It was also stated that she had gone with the applicant, although, allegations of physical relation were also made.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she stated that she was taken by two persons including the applicant on a motorcycle.
The allegation of physical relations were also made.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
5. It appears from the record that the victim had refused to undergo medical examination.
In terms of the Pariwar Registrar and the Birth Certificate on record, the tentative age of the victim is around 18 years and as per the medical report, the age of the victim is around 15-16 years.

In any case, the issue with regard to the age will be determined at the time of trial in view of the law laid down in the case ofMonish vs State of U.P., (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.55026 of 2021), decided on 09.02.2023.
6.

sentences.text: Considering the two statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C.; prima facie, the victim had not supported the prosecution story; the victim had refused to undergo medical examination coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 18.10.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Sebu Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
